description: Extension of CanvasWindowController implementing WKNavigationDelegate methods to handle navigation policies and URL processing within a WebView context in a macOS app.

methods.name: webView(decidePolicyFor:navigationAction:decisionHandler:)
methods.description: Decides whether to allow or cancel navigation actions based on URL schemes, handling deep links, internal navigation, or external URLs.

methods.name: webView(_:didFinish:)
methods.description: Handles completion of navigation, potentially updating UI or debug status.
